title: Proper adjunction comparison for the continuous-coefficient realization
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, let $B_T$ be the sheaf on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] whose sections are continuous $\Omega$-valued functions whose values locally span a finite-dimensional $\mathbf Q_\ell$-subspace. Write $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(B_T)$ for its module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\mathcal D_T\subset D(\mathcal A_T)$ be the full bounded subcategory of the ordinary derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with cohomology sheaves pro-etale locally finite free on a finite locally closed stratification. Identify $B_T$ with the locally finite-extension-valued coefficient sheaf of [lem-sf-adic-qbar-constructible-realization], and use its exact symmetric monoidal equivalence $\rho_T:\mathcal C_T\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal D_T$, where $\mathcal C_T$ is the common-finite-coefficient-field category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients].

Let $p:Z\to Y$ be proper between separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. The coefficient map $p^{-1}B_Y\to B_Z$ is precomposition of functions. Let $L p_B^*=B_Z\otimes^L_{p^{-1}B_Y}p^{-1}(-)$ and $Rp_{*,B}$ be the actual ordinary module derived inverse image and right-derived direct image, with their canonical adjunction [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. Both preserve the indicated bounded constructible subcategories. There is a natural isomorphism
$$a_p:\rho_Z Lp^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lp_B^*\rho_Y.$$
Here $Lp^*\dashv Rp_*$ on $\mathcal C$ uses precisely the common-stage operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-direct-image]. The map $a_p$ is the balanced coefficient-extension comparison on finite-field integral representatives. It preserves the tensor unit and the canonical pullback tensor comparison. Its right-adjoint mate is an isomorphism
$$b_p:\rho_Y Rp_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*,B}\rho_Z.$$
The pair $(a_p,b_p)$ identifies the actual adjunction units and counits. In particular, if $\varepsilon_p:Lp^*Rp_*\to1$ and $\varepsilon_{p,B}:Lp_B^*Rp_{*,B}\to1$ are the two counits, then for every $K\in\mathcal C_Z$
$$\rho_Z(\varepsilon_{p,K})=\varepsilon_{p,B,\rho_ZK}\circ Lp_B^*(b_{p,K})\circ a_{p,Rp_*K}.$$
These assertions concern functors and morphisms in the ordinary module derived categories; no category of derived Frobenius pairs and no projection-formula assertion is part of this statement.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15 (pp. 61-62), with the proper finiteness of Lemma 6.7.2: finite-field continuous realization and its actual ambient operations. Common-stage, tensor-normalized adjunction comparison is an agent-formulated consequence, not a verbatim statement of the proposition.

proof.text: Choose the existing normalized realization Family F. Apply the balanced normalized inverse-image realization to every p and retain its Operations, integral/tensor comparisons, a, integral normalization and tensor/unit equations. No proper-direct-image result is included in that input.

For bounded constructible K on T, the image clause of F writes K ≅ ordinary_T(M). Apply the ordinary pullback to this isomorphism and compose it with a_M. This expresses its pullback as ordinary_Z(Lp*(M)); the image clause on Z gives bounded constructibility.
Apply proper ordinary push preservation to the actual Operations supplied by the inverse-image comparison. In particular Rprime(ordinary_Z(K)) lies in the essential image of ordinary_T.

Use the geometricCommonStageAdjunction for the published common-stage operations, and set m to the right mate of a.inv under this and Operations.adjunction. For each c,d, full faithfulness of the two ordinary realizations, the two adjunction bijections, and a.inv identify Hom(Gc,G(Rd)) with Hom(Gc,Rprime(Hd)). Counit naturality and the mate counit identity show this bijection is postcomposition with m_d. The previous step writes Rprime(Hd) ≅ Gc for some c. Surjectivity at this c gives a right inverse of m_d. Injectivity at Rd makes it a left inverse. Thus all components are invertible and asIso m supplies b with exactly the displayed mate formula. This is the mate-equivalence argument inside the full essential images, without requiring G to be essentially surjective onto the ambient unbounded category.

The Mathlib mate counit identity reads Lprime(b_K) ≫ epsilonprime = a.inv_(RK) ≫ H(epsilon_K). Compose with a.hom_(RK) and cancel the inverse. The Mathlib mate unit identity reads G(eta_M) ≫ b_(LM) = etaprime ≫ Rprime(a.inv_M). Postcompose with Rprime(a.hom_M), combine functorial images of the inverse pair and cancel. These are precisely Comparison.counit and Comparison.unit in the ordinary ambient categories. Fill the Comparison record with these maps and the preceding preservation and normalization fields; instantiate AtSpaces with the Family residue-unit and geometric structure instances.
